To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the $D=5$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) equations admit a family of supersymmetric, non-BPS soliton solutions, and that the $D = 4$, $N = 2$ super Yang-Mill (SYM) equations also admit a family of non-BPS supersymmetric soliton solutions.
there are 1/2 and 1/4 BPS domain wall (Q-kink) solutions and 1/2 BPS string solutions (Q-lumps) in massive $D=4$, $N=2$, supersymmetric sigma-models.

there exist new 1/4 and 1/2 BPS soliton solutions of $D=4$, $N=2$, $U(1)$-gauged, sigma-models that are not Q-bion or Q-kink-lumps, and that they have a realization as calibrated or Q-calibrated branes in M theory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
supersymmetric sigma models, and their realization in M theory as M5-branes.
the study of supersymmetric solitons in $D=4$, $N=2$, and $D=3$, $N=4$ supersymmetric sigma-models, and the corresponding M theory brane configurations in an M monopole background.
the study of the dynamics and topology of $D=4$, $N=2$, supersymmetric sigma models and their M theory realization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

all the static and time-dependent 1/4 and 1/2 BPS solitons of the sigma-model are realized in M theory in a natural way as calibrated M5-branes, and that this provides a novel and powerful method for constructing new supersymmetric solitons.
the $D$-branes of $M$-theory are the solitons of $D$-dimensional supersymmetric sigma models, and vice versa.
the $Q$-lumps are realized in M-theory as M5-branes wrapped on calibrated submanifolds in the M-monopole.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Q-kink-lumps, Q-kinks, and Q-lumps in massive supersymmetric sigma models are realized in M theory by calibrated, or $Q$ calibrated, M5 branes in an M monopole background.
we have found a new class of $Q$-calibrated M5-brane solitonic configurations, and have shown that they are realized as $D$-brane solitons in a class of $D=4$, $N=2$, $Q$-supersymmetric sigma-models.
the $Q$-kinks and $Q$-lumps in the $D=2$ superspace sigma-models have a realization as calibrated M2-branes in M-theory, while the kink-lump has a realization as a calibrated M5-brane in M-theory.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the $Q$-calibrated M5-brane solitonic configurations are realized in a $D=4, N=2$ massive supersymmetric theory as a Q-kink-lumping configuration, and in a $D = 4, N = 1$ supersymmetric theory as an $L$-shaped Q-kink-lumped configuration.
there are many new types of supersymmetric brane configurations that are not captured by the standard BPS counting.
the Q-kink and Q lump are not just static, but are in fact part of the same 1/4 supermultiplet.
